name: ORKS: WEIRDBOY
description:
Weirdboyz are psychically sensitive Oddboyz who serve as focal points for the power unconsciously generated by other Orks. They unwillingly act like a lightning rod for Waaagh! energy, and discharge this power in destructive blasts of force, lest it accumulate and cause their heads to explode.

'Ead Banger

This multipart plastic kit builds a Weirdboy, a support character for your Ork armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Capable of blasting the foe with a torrent of power vomit at mid-range, and whacking them with his copper staff in melee, he deserves a place in your front lines. His powers can enhance nearby Orks and open up new tactical options for the savvy general.

Contents:
– 6 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 50mm Round Hex Hole Base
– 1 construction guide

This push-fit miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour paints
